keyboardHint: The arrow keys move the selected corner or piece of furniture {step}. Delete removes the selected opening or piece of furniture.
selectWallFirst: Select a wall to add a door, window or opening
selectRoomFirst: Select a room to add furniture
removeRoomFurniture: Remove the furniture in the room
lastRoom: The last room cannot be deleted. Delete the floor plan instead.

inspector.title: Selection
inspector.nothingBody: Select a room, a wall, an opening or a piece of furniture in the drawing — or in the list above.
inspector.cornerHint: Drag the corner in the drawing, or move it with the arrow keys. The length of a wall is typed on the wall.
inspector.name: Name
inspector.faceHint: Turns the symbol without moving the item.
inspector.wallTooShort: The wall is too short for a door, a window or an opening.
inspector.slopedHint: Different heights at A and B make the wall sloped. A bend is where the slope changes, like the ridge on a gable wall.
inspector.slopedCeiling: The room has a sloped ceiling: {range}. One ceiling height makes it level.

door.seenFrom: Seen from inside {room}, facing the door.

split.first: Choose the spot on the wall where the dividing line starts.
split.second: Choose where it ends, on another wall.
split.refused: Could not split the room there. The line has to go through the room, from one wall to another.
split.edgeSpot: Middle of the wall between corner {from} and {to} · {length}
